image_description: Two translucent teal plastic disposable lighters standing upright against a white background with faint, blurry text artifacts. The lighter on the left shows a side profile with the spark wheel and guard visible. The lighter on the right is angled slightly differently, showing the front/top nozzle area. Both appear to be standard Bic-style disposable lighters.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The proportions relative to the standard shape of a disposable lighter indicate a handheld size (approx. 8cm tall).

The object is self-contained and designed for portability.

artifact_observations.location: Background, primarily right side and bottom left
artifact_observations.reasoning: Faint, nonsensical letter-like shapes and loops float in the white background. They do not form readable words and appear to be AI hallucinations of text or watermarks.

The internal refraction and the 'liquid' look inside the plastic bodies are slightly inconsistent. The right lighter's internal tube seems to fade out unnaturally, and the surface highlights lack sharp specular definition typical of hard plastic.

artifact_observations.location: Top metal hood of the right lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal windguard/hood on the right lighter appears slightly melted or fused into the plastic neck. The geometry of the spark wheel area is less defined than on the left lighter, lacking clear mechanical separation.
